svg.text: Cars in the way: what the engine offers
Each free cell ahead of you shows the move points it costs, or a cross when it is not offered.
Drawn as on the board, travel left to right; the number in a plain dot is its forwardIndex.
A cell in your own zone is never offered: a car only moves forward, straight or diagonally.
Cars in the next lane are no cap: a lane change may pass any number of them
Two cars in lane 3: the cells between, and past, both are offered; each price is its route's.
A pack in the next lane: past it by the free lane, as far as the budget reaches
Four cars in lane 1, lane 2 free: 7 cells down lane 2 and in is 8 points, one more is 9, then the cap.
A full row cannot be passed: occupied cells are never driven through
With no free way round, nothing beyond the row is offered, in any lane.
